signature: „IOHAN SIEG / MVND**** GRAF / IN OPERNEV / PRVN**** 1768“
dimensions: bo1 11.1, bo2 10 (damage), slide sec. 1649, bell section 1028.5, overlap 29, le 2648.5, be 153, mp receiver 11.9, slide sec. exit 11.1.
remarks: Examined by the author, July 1998. Plain tubular slide stays, moveable one telescopic, long brass patch, ca. 115 x 9, on outer slide of descending tube. No ring in slide bow; long oblong slide bow guard with bumper in center. Ferrules have ring pattern. Repair on immoveable slide stay at bottom, and on adjacent ferrule. One flat bell stay, decorated on both sides with circles and half-circles; hinge on bell pipe side. Elaborate repoussé work on garland, hunting scene showing men with rifles, stags, trees, dogs. Small guard on bell bow; might be repair. Ring in bell bow, attached to plain saddle. Ferrules on bell sec. do not match ferrules on slide sec.; rings on ferrules on bell sec. more widely spaced. Bell shows considerable repair near end; long brass tab ca. 100 x 55 on inside of garland; adjacent to this is another brass tab, ca. 45 wide, running approximately halfway around the bell. At upper edge of garland is a ring, with five-lobed shells. Rim wire has leaf pattern.
